channel.title: International Business Times India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: US arms sales to Taiwan: Bolstering asymmetric deterrence in face of escalating cross-strait tensions
item.description: The U.S. approved an unprecedented $11.1 billion arms package to Taiwan, including M109A7 self-propelled howitzers, Javelin and TOW missiles, and other systems, marking a significant escalation in support amid growing Chinese pressure.

item.title: Suspected 'Love Jihad' case in Bengaluru, Kolkata woman lodges police complaint
item.description: The woman recorded a viral video detailing her ordeal, claiming the accused and his family refused her shelter and threatened her advocate.

item.title: Ranveer Singh receives threatening WhatsApp voice note demanding crores, security beefed up
item.description: Ranveer Singh received a threatening WhatsApp voice note demanding crores, following the shooting at Rohit Shetty's house; Mumbai Police were informed immediately.

item.title: Article 370 row, CM's remarks trigger chaos in J&K Assembly
item.description: The J&K Legislative Assembly witnessed repeated disruptions after Chief Minister Omar Abdullah's remarks on the Indo–US trade deal and comments during the budget discussion sparked strong protests from BJP legislators. The BJP accused the Chief Minister of using objectionable language and demanded an unconditional apology.

item.title: Govinda justifies wife Sunita Ahuja's extramarital affair claims, reveals Sajid Nadiadwala launched his son; fans call his remarks 'childish'
item.description: Amid multiple interviews where Sunita Ahuja discussed Govinda's extramarital affairs and his alleged absence in supporting their son Yashvardhan's film career, Govinda, on Tuesday, responded to her statements firmly, dismissing allegations of an extramarital affair and speaking about his dedication to his work and professional conduct in the film industry.

item.title: Pandit Deendayal Upadhyaya's principles continue to remain guiding light, says PM Modi
item.description: On the death anniversary of Pandit Deendayal Upadhyaya, Prime Minister Narendra Modi, along with other leaders including Amit Shah, Rajnath Singh, and Uttar Pradesh CM Yogi Adityanath, paid tributes to the visionary leader. Upadhyaya, a key figure in Bharatiya Jana Sangh, is remembered for his philosophy of Integral Humanism (Ekatma Manav Darshan) and the principle of Antyodaya, emphasizing holistic development rooted in India's cultural ethos.

item.title: Sensex, Nifty trade higher over sustained foreign inflows
item.description: As of 9.23 am, Sensex added 122 points, or 0.14 per cent, to reach 84,396, and Nifty gained 50 points, or 0.19 per cent, to settle at 25,985.

item.title: Allu Arjun to take legal action against Kaveri Baruah for making false allegations
item.description: Stylish star Allu Arjun's team is set to take legal action against Kaveri Baruah for making false claims that she was asked to follow strict rules while meeting the actor.

item.title: White House pushes back on Epstein questions
item.description: The White House pushed back on renewed questions about President Donald Trump's past ties to Jeffrey Epstein, emphasizing that Trump had distanced himself from Epstein and expelled him from Mar-a-Lago.

item.title: Nine killed in mass-shooting at Canada school, suspect dead by suicide
item.description: The suspected shooter, described as a woman or someone in female attire, was found dead at the school, apparently by suicide. About 100 staff and students were safely evacuated.
